However, more importantly, the use of exclusive or (⊕) implies that only one of the two traits must be true. So this FOL likely fails to capture the correct logical dependency. In contrast, the natural language says 'if they either care for others or listen actively (but not both?)' — the 'either ... or' in English can be ambiguous, but with ⊕ it's strictly exclusive. But in context, the natural language likely intends inclusive or. Hence, using ⊕ instead of ∨ is a likely mistake. Moreover, concluding ¬p_3(x) (not empathetic) from such traits is backwards. So unless this is a deliberately paradoxical or ironic system, this FOL statement does not correctly correspond to the NL statement — not because of syntax, but because of meaning mismatch due to incorrect logical structure and implausible implication.
